# qualys_vm_report_templates (Data Source)

Look up Qualys report templates, for referencing a template ID when
launching a report. This is read-only: report templates have no
create/update/delete API of their own for most types (only scan, PCI scan
and patch templates do, each with its own dedicated endpoint), and this list
is the only surface that enumerates templates of every type together.

There is no `qualys_report_template` resource, and none is planned: report
*launches* are asynchronous jobs with no stable lifecycle to converge on, so
this provider treats reporting as an imperative operation, not
configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qualys_vm_report_templates" "scan" {
  template_type = "Scan"
}

output "scan_template_ids" {
  value = [for t in data.qualys_vm_report_templates.scan.report_templates : t.id]
}
```

## A note on the underlying API

This data source is backed by the legacy V1 `report_template_list.php`
script rather than the versioned `/api/2.0/fo/...` family — it is the only
listing surface that exists for report templates of every type, so it is
used here deliberately rather than avoided as a legacy generation (see
`docs/discovery/09-mvp-sequence.md` §18). It takes no filter parameters;
`title_contains` and `template_type` are applied client-side, after the API
call.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **template_type** (String) Filter results to this template type, for example `Scan` or `Policy`. Applied client-side.
- **title_contains** (String) Filter results to templates whose title contains this substring (case-insensitive). Applied client-side — the underlying list API takes no filter parameters at all.

### Read-Only

- **report_templates** (List of Object) Matching report templates, ordered by ID for stable output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report_templates))

<a id="nestedatt--report_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report_templates`

Read-Only:

- **global** (Boolean)
- **id** (String)
- **last_update** (String)
- **owner_login** (String)
- **owner_name** (String)
- **template_type** (String)
- **title** (String)
- **type** (String)
